additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374088-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R2 170001476] Unexpected error 404 CRM:00642001403
additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon,
Greetings of the day.
We checked the charger logs and can see that it does not have active internet connection.
2024-08-14T02:14:10.562079+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/06a3943e2e31[713]: [ensureOCPPConnection] router2 - [isMobileConnected] routerIp: 10.20.17.2 connstate: {"stdout":"
disconnected
\n","stderr":""}
To reset the network connection we logged into the router remotely and found that SIM is not inserted.
Please plan a site intervention to check SIM on this charger, carry one spare router and working SIM with yourself.
Points to check on site:
Working status of SIM
Whether SIM is inserted into router properly or not.
Any damage to SIM tray
If router still not detects SIM, replace the router.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
